locator.text: Display 29.8, p. 29, in the proof of Lemma 4.4

evidence: paper: \Delta H = \sqrt{2X}\,\Delta E, \qquad \Delta W = -\frac{2D\eta\,\Delta M + d\,\partial_\eta \Delta M}{X}, \qquad \Delta\Pi = \Delta C_p .

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Only the third identity is stated as a difference identity. Delta Pi = Delta C_p is row 4 of profileRows_sub (ModulatedHistories.lean:651): with the shared axis datum hp : P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0, the difference of the five rows equals the difference of the bare cumulative integrals, and row 4 of densityAt is f^2 = E^2/(2X) (density_eq_physical, X > 0). The sign convention is P - Q rather than the paper's f_2 - f_1, which is immaterial. The other two identities are not stated anywhere as differences (my search of decls.jsonl for a difference of two W's, H's or pressures found only profileRows_sub and unrelated declarations). Each follows from stated Lean by subtracting two instances of a per-profile formula: Delta H = sqrt(2X) Delta E from the definitions Profiles.H = 2Xf and Profiles.E = sqrt(2X) f with sqrt(2X)^2 = 2X (or, in the SeedHandbackJets encoding, H is written inline as Real.sqrt (2*X) * p 0 η in stocks_formulas and Profile.density, so the identity is distributivity); Delta W from the W bound in the statement of stocks_formulas line 96, (X - 2 D η M - d ∂_η M)/X, or from XW_eq_histories with parameterPartial_primitive, by subtraction and division by X, plus linearity of the η-derivative under the smoothness that is a hypothesis (PairBound.smooth_left/right, Profiles.U_smooth). These steps are algebra and unfolding of stated definitions; no unstated analytic fact is needed. The Lean proof of the surrounding estimate (4.17) (stocks_comparison, profile_comparison, profile_comparison_norm) does not form these identities: it propagates difference bounds through PolynomialExpression.eval_pairBound, with the common radial factors and common P₀ entering via PairBound.same (difference coefficient 0). So the route differs, but the display itself is derivable, which is what the decision rule asks. Strictly, the Lean's per-profile formulas say more than the Delta identities; I class it equivalent because the paper has the same per-profile formulas in force in the preceding display. I did not check that the two Lean encodings (ProfileHistories.Profiles and SeedHandbackJets.Profile) are linked by a declaration.
